name: FS2024 Frame
description: Input, Quake 3 movement over the streamed ground, then streaming, sky, ground and the composite.

steps.comment: Re-centres engine space on the player past 40 km, so a flight of any length keeps FS2024's own scale and full float precision; resident tiles are rebuilt in the new space.
Runs after movement, so it centres on the origin this frame produced rather than the last one's.
HDR target, supersampled; the composite resolves it and sharpens.
Records the window to H.264 when SDL3CPP_RECORD (or output_path) names a .mp4/.mkv; otherwise does nothing. Everything drawn after this goes into a texture video.record.end reads back.
Draws every streamed-in tile with its own ground texture; an airport tile's runway markings are drawn sharp by the shader from that tile's own roads.json.
Frame to grab an in-engine screenshot on (about two seconds in, once tiles have streamed). Nothing is written unless FS2024_SHOT names a file.

Where to save one frame. Empty (the default) writes nothing; put a path here to have the engine save the frame it drew itself -- a swapchain read-back, so it never captures anything else that happens to be on screen.
Saves the frame the engine just drew when a path was set this frame (a swapchain read-back, not a desktop grab); silent otherwise.
Puts the recorded frame on screen and queues its download. Last thing before the submit: nothing may draw to the swapchain after it.
Without this the frame lands in a target nobody presents.
